captions.detailed: A realistic, industrial-grade CCTV mast assembly. It features a tall, vertical support pole anchored to a circular base plate with bolting hardware, a mid-height junction box with a vertical conduit running up the backside, and a top-mounted pan-tilt camera assembly. The camera head consists of a rectangular housing, a dark circular lens, and a dual-bracket yoke mount. The assembly is colored in industrial gray tones, with black accents for the bolts, lens, and wiring, and a small warning label on the junction box.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a realistic CCTV surveillance mast. The model should include a circular mounting flange with bolts, a main vertical pole, a junction box with rear conduit, and a top-mounted pan-tilt camera head with a dual-bracket yoke and a dark cylindrical camera lens. Apply appropriate industrial gray and black materials.
captions.factory: Construct the base plate using a thin cylinder, adding smaller cylinders around its perimeter to represent anchor bolts. Extrude a tall cylinder for the main vertical pole. Model the junction box as a box primitive and the conduit as a narrow cylinder along the rear of the pole. For the camera assembly, construct a rectangular pan-tilt base, a U-shaped yoke bracket using combined box shapes, a rectangular camera housing, and a dark cylindrical lens protruding from the front. Assemble these components hierarchically with defined rotation axes for pan and tilt articulations.
